title: ornanthes americana
intro: Ornanthes americana, commonly known as American Goldenseal, is a perennial plant native to the southeastern United States. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is a member of the Berberidaceae family. The health benefits of American Goldenseal include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include berberine, a compound with therapeutic actions that include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and heal wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues.
